structure.unit: Uniform Foreign-Country Money Judgments Recognition Act

law.catch_line: Effect of recognition of foreign-country judgment
law.text:
If the court in a proceeding under § 8.01-465.13:5 finds that the foreign-country judgment is entitled to recognition under this chapter then, to the extent that the foreign-country judgment grants or denies recovery of a sum of money, the foreign-country judgment is:
Conclusive between the parties to the same extent as the judgment of a sister state entitled to full faith and credit in the Commonwealth would be conclusive; and
Enforceable in the same manner and to the same extent as a judgment rendered in the Commonwealth.
